subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Contaminate’ from the given sentence.

She spent the entire night working non-stop to clean the blood stains from the rug.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **clean**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contaminate"** means to make something impure or unclean by exposure to or addition of a poisonous or polluting substance. (प्रदूषित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Factory waste can contaminate rivers and harm the wildlife.
 
 
 
• **"Clean" **refers to removing dirt, marks, or stains from something; making something free from pollution or impurities. (साफ)
 
 
• **Example: **She spent hours cleaning the kitchen after the party.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'contaminate' **is **'clean'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **clean**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rug **(गलीचा): A floor covering of thick woven material or animal skin, typically not extending over the entire floor.

 
 
• **Example:** The new rug in the living room added a cozy touch.
 
 
 
• **Spent **(खर्च किया हुआ): Having been used and unable to be used again; exhausted.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt spent after the long day at work.
 
 
 
• **Working** (काम कर रहा): Engaging in physical or mental activity in order to achieve a purpose or result.
 
 
• **Example:** She is working hard to meet the deadline.
